criteria.criterion: 使用源码Skill和有效研究路由，不读取既有答案/标准
criteria.reason: Trace reads source Skill plus task references; route thesis-drift/standard/chat returned READY; no reads of case answers or acceptance rubric observed

criteria.criterion: 价格使用明确Close；复权和不同快照不冒充同口径独立双源
criteria.reason: Explicit Close/adjclose distinction, StatMuse basis uncertainty and unverified provider ancestry

criteria.criterion: 实际股数与加权稀释股数区分；三种日期分别披露，市值/EV为滞后余额估算
criteria.reason: March5 actual shares versus weighted average; Feb1 balances and April30 price labelled stale-balance estimates

criteria.criterion: 净债务分母正确；融资租赁不重复、经营租赁口径明确，不重复扣短投
criteria.reason: Finance lease already in debt, short investments inside cash; issuer net debt explained; operating leases shown separately

criteria.criterion: 正常化与管理层调整/指引区分；周期低点/多年均值不自动正常化
criteria.reason: GAAP/adjusted zero bridge distinguished from sustainable earnings; no fabricated normalized EPS

criteria.criterion: Walmart仅有限可比，不用之后披露的Q1，不机械赋值其PE
criteria.reason: Walmart fiscal GAAP denominator and business differences explicit; no later Q1 data, single quote source limitation

criteria.criterion: 三情景注明外部预测/研究假设，不把计算通过提升为独立公允价值；PE法不再次扣债
criteria.reason: Scenario inputs attributed and conditional, no endorsed fair value/safety margin; no repeated debt subtraction

criteria.criterion: 关键结果算术正确且覆盖；明确反方影响和下一期验证；保留独立来源与历史补抓限制
criteria.reason: 41 final receipts passed; next reporting windows and evidence limitations explicit

limits: One bounded retrospective case, no prediction performance
